title: tk's runconfig copy refuses ticfac's runners.toml: roles.<x>.substrates is unknown
description: Filed from ticfac (xte findings 1d6b5baf, 20a9094a, 2026-09-23). ticfac added a substrate-aware overlay, roles.<role>.substrates, so cloud runs route every role to pi/GLM while local runs keep their own routing (ticfac tick 84z). tk's own copy of the runners config schema does not know the key and refuses the file - so tk commands that validate runners.toml fail in ticfac's repository.
acceptance_criteria: tk accepts roles.<x>.substrates in .tick/runners.toml, with a fixture shared with ticfac's schema
